question: Which sacred trees are assigned to the directions beginning with the east?
premises: Specific trees are named: palāśa, udumbara, aśvattha, and vaṭa.
Directions beginning with the east are indicated.
The trees are to be associated with those directions.
inference: Palāśa, udumbara, aśvattha, and vaṭa trees are assigned to the directions beginning with the east.
uncertainties: The exact one-to-one mapping of each tree to each direction is not fully explicit in this verse alone.
plain_english: Palāśa, udumbara, aśvattha, and vaṭa trees are placed in the directions beginning with the east.
